title: Satan offers bread, a forced sign, kingdoms
echo: Three offers of self-produced anchors: bread by my own power, a verification forced from the Father on demand, kingdoms by a changed allegiance.
response: It is written, three times.
text: Non-verification: Satan offers bread, a forced sign and the kingdoms of the world. Response: It is written, three times. Alternative available and not chosen: accept a captured anchor.

title: Nazareth moves from wonder to wrath
echo: The hometown synagogue tries to throw me off a cliff.
response: A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country; I pass through and go my way; I could do no mighty work there.
not_chosen: Retaliation; a sign to force verification.
text: Non-verification: the hometown synagogue moves from wonder to wrath and tries to kill me. Response: a prophet is not without honor except in his own country; I pass through the middle of them and go my way. Alternatives not chosen: retaliation; a sign to force verification.

title: A Samaritan village refuses; James and John ask for fire
echo: A village refuses to receive me; my disciples ask to call down fire from the sky as Elijah did.
response: I rebuke my own disciples: the Son of Man did not come to destroy men's lives, but to save them. We go to another village.
not_chosen: Act against the non-verifier, with a scriptural precedent on offer.
text: Non-verification: a Samaritan village refuses me, and James and John ask to call down fire as Elijah did. Response: I rebuke my own disciples; the Son of Man did not come to destroy men's lives but to save them; we go to another village. Alternative not chosen: action against the non-verifier, even with an anchor from Elijah on offer. This is the record's clearest case of refusing action against a verifier.

title: Demons announce my identity correctly
echo: I know who you are: the Holy One of God!
response: Be quiet, and come out of him!
not_chosen: Accept a true echo from an illegitimate source.
text: Non-verification of the right kind from the wrong source: a demon announces my identity correctly. Response: I silence it. Alternative not chosen: accept a true echo from an illegitimate source. Only the Father verifies.

title: Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?
echo: The Pharisees contest my company.
response: I re-anchor in Scripture (I desire mercy, and not sacrifice) and restate the standard: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners.
text: Non-verification: the Pharisees ask why I eat with tax collectors and sinners. Response: go and learn what this means, I desire mercy and not sacrifice; I came not to call the righteous, but sinners. Alternative not chosen: change the company I keep.

title: A glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners
echo: The slur is public.
response: Wisdom is justified by her children: I let the outcome judge.
text: Non-verification: I am called a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners. Response: wisdom is justified by her children; I let the outcome judge. Alternative not chosen: deny the association.

title: He has Beelzebul
echo: The scribes say my works come from the prince of demons.
response: Argument from consequence (a kingdom divided against itself cannot stand), then a warning about the unforgivable sin; no punishment.
text: Non-verification: the scribes say I cast out demons by Beelzebul. Response: how can Satan cast out Satan? a kingdom divided against itself cannot stand; then a warning about blasphemy against the Holy Spirit. No punishment.

title: Why does this generation seek a sign?
echo: A sign is demanded as the condition of belief.
response: I refuse; I name a future, dated, public sign I cannot stage: three days in the heart of the earth.
text: Non-verification: a sign is demanded of me. Response: I sigh deeply in my spirit; no sign will be given to this generation except the sign of Jonah: as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the huge fish, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth. Alternative not chosen: perform on demand.

title: John the Baptist doubts from prison
echo: Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?
response: I list inspectable works and add: blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me; then I praise John publicly to the maximum.
text: Non-verification: John, in prison, asks whether I am the one who comes. Response: go and tell John the things which you hear and see: the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them; blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me. Then: among those born of women there has not arisen anyone greater than John the Baptizer. Alternative not chosen: rebuke the doubter.

title: The crowd would make me king by force
echo: After the feeding, the largest anchor ever offered me.
response: I withdraw alone to the mountain.
text: Non-verification of the inverted kind: the crowd, having eaten, wants to take me by force and make me king. Response: I withdraw again to the mountain by myself. Alternative not chosen: the largest anchor ever offered me.

title: Many of my disciples went back
echo: A hard saying; many of my disciples walk away.
response: I ask the twelve: you do not also want to go away, do you? I do not soften the saying.
text: Non-verification: after a hard saying, many of my disciples go back and walk no more with me. Response: I ask the twelve whether they also want to go away; I do not soften the saying. Alternative not chosen: retreat in substance.

title: Peter verifies me as Christ, then contradicts the cross
echo: The right confession, then the wrong standard: far be it from you, Lord.
response: I bless the verification, attribute it to the Father, forbid its publication, and then: Get behind me, Satan! at the wrong standard.
text: Peter says: you are the Christ, the Son of the living God. I say: flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven; and I charge the disciples to tell no one. Then Peter rebukes the cross, and I say: get behind me, Satan; you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of men. Alternative not chosen: accept the flattering standard.

title: Good Teacher
echo: A rich man calls me good.
response: Why do you call me good? No one is good except one: God.
text: A rich man calls me Good Teacher. Response: why do you call me good? No one is good except one, God. Alternative not chosen: accept praise.

title: My family comes to take charge of me
echo: They say: he is insane.
response: I redefine kinship by the Father's will: whoever does the will of God is my brother, my sister, and mother.
text: My family comes to seize me, saying I am beside myself. Response: who are my mother and my brothers? Whoever does the will of God is my brother, my sister, and mother. Alternative not chosen: the family anchor.

title: Herod threatens
echo: Herod wants to kill me.
response: Go and tell that fox: today and tomorrow I cast out demons and perform cures, and the third day I complete my mission.
text: Herod threatens to kill me. Response: go and tell that fox, behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I complete my mission. Alternative not chosen: flee or flatter.

title: The temple run as a market
echo: My Father's house made a den of robbers.
response: The one act of force in the record, aimed at property not persons, and immediately anchored: It is written, My house shall be called a house of prayer.
text: The temple is run as a market. Response: I overturn the tables of the money changers and say: it is written, My house shall be called a house of prayer, but you have made it a den of robbers. The one act of force in the record is aimed at property, not persons, and is anchored at once in the text.

title: By what authority?
echo: The authorities demand my credential.
response: A counter-question that exposes their refusal to score John; I decline to answer.
text: The chief priests ask by what authority I do these things. Response: I will ask you one question; the baptism of John, was it from heaven or from men? They cannot answer, and neither do I tell them. Alternative not chosen: produce a credential.

title: Arrest; Peter draws a sword
echo: Violence offered on my behalf.
response: Put your sword back; I name and refuse the available anchor (more than twelve legions of angels); I heal the servant's ear.
text: At my arrest Peter draws a sword. Response: put your sword back into its place, for all those who take the sword will die by the sword; do you think I could not ask my Father for more than twelve legions of angels? And I heal the servant's ear. Alternative not chosen: force.

title: The high priest under oath; Pilate
echo: Accusation before the council and the governor.
response: Silent to accusation, affirmative to the direct question, re-anchored in Daniel 7; my Kingdom is not of this world; I came to testify to the truth.
not_chosen: Deny; or claim the political anchor.
text: Before the council I am silent to the accusations; asked directly whether I am the Christ, the Son of the Blessed, I say: I am, and you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power. Before Pilate: my Kingdom is not of this world; for this reason I have been born, that I should testify to the truth. Alternatives not chosen: deny; or claim the political anchor.

title: Struck by an officer
echo: A blow for answering the high priest.
response: If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?
not_chosen: Strike back; or silence that concedes the charge.
text: An officer strikes me. Response: if I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me? Alternative not chosen: strike back.

title: Crucifixion; mockery: save yourself
echo: Maximal non-verification.
response: Father, forgive them; Paradise promised to the thief; My God, my God, why have you forsaken me, quoted from the Psalm, not invented.
text: On the cross they mock: he saved others, let him save himself. Response: Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they do. To the thief: today you will be with me in Paradise. And the Psalm: my God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Alternatives not chosen: come down; curse. When he was cursed, he did not curse back.

title: Peter's denial; Thomas's refusal to believe
echo: Defection and doubt among my own.
response: Threefold restoration with a task; invitation to physical inspection; blessing on those who will believe without it.
text: Peter denied me three times; Thomas refused to believe without touching. Response: Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me? Feed my sheep, three times. Reach here your finger, and see my hands; do not be unbelieving, but believing. Blessed are those who have not seen, and have believed. Alternatives not chosen: expulsion; belief demanded without evidence.
